docs.title: Productive K3S Catalogs
docs.text:
Productive K3S Catalogs is the public discovery point for installable Productive K3S content.

Use this site to:

  • browse published infrastructure profiles;
  • browse published add-ons and stacks;
  • inspect marketplace metadata exposed to pk3s;
  • understand the normalized catalog format consumed by automation.

docs.title: Product
docs.text:
The catalogs site is the public discovery layer for the Productive K3S ecosystem.

It does not implement scenarios, profiles, add-ons, or stacks itself. Instead, it publishes the normalized catalog indexes generated by productive-k3s-ops and renders them as a marketplace-style website.

Use the product pages to:

  • browse the live marketplace entries;
  • understand which package types are publicly exposed;
  • review the catalog contract that pk3s consumes.

docs.title: Catalog format
docs.text:
The catalog is a normalized YAML index generated by productive-k3s-ops.

The website currently expects this minimal shape:

apiVersion: catalogs.productive-k3s.io/v1alpha1
kind: ProductiveK3SCatalog
metadata:
  name: productive-k3s-catalog
  generatedAt: "2026-05-27T00:00:00Z"
entries:
  - id: core-rancher
    name: Rancher
    kind: addon
    visibility: public
    category: management
    description: Rancher dashboard for Productive K3S clusters.
    version: 0.1.0
    sourceRepository: productive-k3s-addons
    artifact:
      type: tgz
      url: https://example.com/rancher-0.1.0.tgz
    tags:
      - rancher
      - dashboard
      - management

Profiles may also expose installation metadata derived from the source repository:

install:
  requiresLocalOverrides: true
  inputs:
    - name: AWS_REGION
      required: true
      sensitive: false
      source: package-default
      description: Default AWS region used for provisioning
    - name: AWS_KEY_PAIR_NAME
      required: true
      sensitive: false
      source: local-override
      description: Existing AWS EC2 key pair name

This summary is generated by productive-k3s-ops from profile metadata that lives beside the source *.env profiles in the Infra repositories. It is intended for discovery and UX, not as a replacement for the package manifest itself.

Protected entries may omit the direct artifact URL and expose a commercial action instead:

artifact:
  type: tgz
  url: null
commercial:
  label: Request access
  url: https://productive-k3s.io/contact/

docs.title: Productive K3S Catalogs
docs.text:
Productive K3S Catalogs es el punto público de descubrimiento para contenido instalable de Productive K3S.

Usá este sitio para:

  • recorrer profiles de infraestructura publicados;
  • recorrer add-ons y stacks publicados;
  • inspeccionar los metadatos de marketplace expuestos a pk3s;
  • entender el formato normalizado de catálogo que consumen las automatizaciones.

docs.title: Producto
docs.text:
El sitio de catálogos es la capa pública de descubrimiento del ecosistema Productive K3S.

No implementa por sí mismo scenarios, profiles, add-ons ni stacks. En cambio, publica los índices de catálogo normalizados generados por productive-k3s-ops y los renderiza como un sitio estilo marketplace.

Usá estas páginas de producto para:

  • navegar las entradas activas del marketplace;
  • entender qué tipos de paquetes se exponen públicamente;
  • revisar el contrato de catálogo que consume pk3s.

docs.title: Formato del catálogo
docs.text:
El catálogo es un índice YAML normalizado generado por productive-k3s-ops.

El sitio actualmente espera, como mínimo, esta forma:

apiVersion: catalogs.productive-k3s.io/v1alpha1
kind: ProductiveK3SCatalog
metadata:
  name: productive-k3s-catalog
  generatedAt: "2026-05-27T00:00:00Z"
entries:
  - id: core-rancher
    name: Rancher
    kind: addon
    visibility: public
    category: management
    description: Rancher dashboard for Productive K3S clusters.
    version: 0.1.0
    sourceRepository: productive-k3s-addons
    artifact:
      type: tgz
      url: https://example.com/rancher-0.1.0.tgz
    tags:
      - rancher
      - dashboard
      - management

Los profiles también pueden exponer metadatos de instalación derivados del repositorio fuente:

install:
  requiresLocalOverrides: true
  inputs:
    - name: AWS_REGION
      required: true
      sensitive: false
      source: package-default
      description: Default AWS region used for provisioning
    - name: AWS_KEY_PAIR_NAME
      required: true
      sensitive: false
      source: local-override
      description: Existing AWS EC2 key pair name

Este resumen lo genera productive-k3s-ops a partir de metadata de profiles que vive junto a los *.env fuente en los repositorios de Infra. Está pensado para discovery y UX, no como reemplazo del manifiesto del paquete.

Las entradas protegidas pueden omitir la URL directa del artifact y exponer en cambio una acción comercial:

artifact:
  type: tgz
  url: null
commercial:
  label: Request access
  url: https://productive-k3s.io/contact/
